scene.title: From the machine to the part
scene.lead: A lockstitch hook assembly, taken apart the way a parts book shows it. Every numbered part is a category we stock, listed under its OEM part number.
scene.figAria: Exploded technical drawing of a lockstitch hook assembly: 1 rotary hook, 2 bobbin case, 3 bobbin, 4 feed dog, 5 presser foot, 6 needle.

notes.hook: Catches the needle thread to form each stitch. A worn point means skipped stitches.
notes.bobbinCase: Holds the bobbin; its spring sets the lower-thread tension.
notes.bobbin: Carries the lower thread. Must match the hook type.
notes.feedDog: Moves the fabric between stitches. Tooth pitch suits the fabric weight.
notes.presserFoot: Holds the fabric on the feed dog — standard, compensating or special.
notes.needle: System and size (e.g. DB×1 #14) must match machine and fabric.

about.metaDescription: Rakib Enterprise, Mirpur-1, Dhaka — 35+ years in the garment-machine parts trade. Importer and supplier of spare parts and devices for industrial sewing machines, with VAT invoices (BIN 002328131-0401).
about.title: Spare parts and devices for the machines that keep garment lines running.
about.lead: From Mirpur-1, Dhaka, we import and supply spare parts and devices for industrial sewing machines — not the machines themselves — to garment factories, maintenance teams, mechanics and resellers.

story.p1: Rakib Enterprise is a garment-machine parts house in Mirpur-1, Dhaka, with more than 35 years in the trade. Under its proprietor, Md. Abul Hossain, we import and supply spare parts and devices for industrial sewing machines — for garment factories, mechanics and resellers.
story.p2: We are a registered business, with a trade licence from Dhaka North City Corporation and VAT registration (BIN <mono>{bin}</mono>), so factories can get a proper VAT invoice for what they buy.
story.p3: We work from part numbers, machine models and photos of the old part. If we are not sure a part fits, we ask before we quote.

about.stockSub: Parts and devices for these brands, by type — all searchable by part number.
about.policySub: You always know which one you are buying.

policy.genuineBody: Made or approved by the machine manufacturer and sold under the original part number. We recommend these for electronics, timing parts and machines under warranty.
policy.compatibleBody: Made by specialist manufacturers to the OEM dimensions and part number — needles, hooks, feed dogs, knives. Same fit, often easier to get.
policy.labelBody: Every listing shows the parts brand, the grade and the OEM part number. Quotes state the same, line by line.

about.processSub: From the first message to the part on the machine.

1.title: Send what you have
1.body: A part number, a list, an Excel sheet or a photo of the old part — on WhatsApp, by phone or through the quote form.

5.title: Dispatch from Dhaka

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.summary: Where we deliver, how delivery time is confirmed, and what to check when your parts arrive.

p: We deliver across Bangladesh from Dhaka — by our own delivery in and around Dhaka and the main garment areas, and by courier service elsewhere.
Delivery time depends on stock and location. We confirm the expected time on your quotation or when we confirm your order. Parts that we need to source take longer; the quotation says so.
For urgent, line-down requests, contact us by phone or WhatsApp and ask what is possible.
Delivery charges, if any, are stated on the quotation or shown at checkout before you confirm.

list: Check that the parcel is sealed and undamaged.
Check the part numbers and quantities against the invoice.
Report damage, missing items or a wrong part within 2 days of delivery, with your order or quote reference and photos.

returns.title: Returns & wrong-part exchange
returns.summary: What happens if we send the wrong part, if you ordered the wrong one, or if a part is faulty.

p: If the part does not match the part number we confirmed on your quotation or order, we exchange it or refund it, and we cover the delivery. Tell us within 7 days of delivery with your reference and photos.
We can usually exchange a part within 7 days of delivery if it is unused, undamaged and in its original packaging. Delivery costs for the exchange may be charged.

Report a fault as soon as you notice it. We check the part — with the supplier if needed — and repair, replace or refund it if the fault is confirmed. Warranty applies only where it is stated on the quotation or invoice.

list: Parts that have been installed or used, except for confirmed faults.
Electrical and electronic parts (motors, control boxes) once installed, except for confirmed faults.
Parts sourced or imported specially for your order, unless we sent the wrong part.
Consumables cut or opened from bulk packs.

p: Contact us by phone or WhatsApp with your order or quote reference before sending anything back. We tell you how to return it.

payment.title: Payment
payment.summary: Quotations, payment methods and how to pay safely.

p: Most prices are given by quotation. A quotation states the price, currency (BDT), availability and how long it is valid. Prices may change after the validity date.

list: bKash / Nagad — ask us for the current details.

p: Only pay into the accounts printed on our quotation or invoice. We will never ask you to pay into a personal account in a chat. If payment details look different, call us before paying.
We issue an invoice for every order. If you need a VAT invoice, give your company name and BIN with your quote request or order, and we confirm what we can issue.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.summary: What information we collect when you request a quote or order, and how we use it.

list: Contact details you give us: name, phone, email, company name, BIN and delivery address.
Your requests: parts lists, files and photos you upload, messages and orders.
Technical data such as IP address and browser type, used to keep the site working and to prevent abuse.

p: To answer your requests, prepare quotations, deliver orders, issue invoices and provide support. We do not sell your information.
Delivery partners receive what they need to deliver (name, phone, address). We share information with authorities only when the law requires it.
The quote list and cart are kept in your own browser until you send them; we receive them only when you submit a request or an order.
We keep business records — quotations, orders, invoices — for as long as needed for business and legal purposes.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information through our [contact page](/contact).

terms.title: Terms
terms.summary: The basic terms for using this site, quotations and orders.

p: We work to keep part numbers, compatibility, stock and descriptions accurate, but errors can happen and images may be illustrative. Please confirm the part number and machine model before ordering — we are happy to check for you.
A quotation is valid for the period stated on it. Stock is not reserved until you confirm and we accept the order.

An order is accepted when we confirm it by phone, message or email. We may decline or cancel an order, for example if a part is no longer available or a price was wrong — any payment made is then refunded.
Parts are labelled Genuine, OEM or Compatible as supplied to us. Brand and machine names are used only to identify which machines a part fits.
Our liability for a part is limited to its price. We are not responsible for losses from production downtime or incorrect installation, to the extent the law allows.
These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.
